The builder is likely to recover **$14,000**. Expectation damages put him where full performance would have, so he gets the $20,000 price minus the $5,000 he saved by not finishing, plus the $1,000 resale he received for materials he already bought ($10,000 spent + $5,000 profit − $1,000 resale). The $3,000 increase in property value measures restitution, which is not the expectation measure here.

CONFIDENCE: 80
